_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Wena Mdlali {player_id} eThree-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Isigino sakho sishi '{symbol}'.
Unemfuno wokwenza izinhlelo zakho zisigino esiphepheni esilulenkulu 5x5 ukwakha uluku olunezindlela ezine.
Izindlela zingakafikiwa ngokwesikhashana, ngokwesiqabane, nangokwezintsimu.
Nikela igibelo lakho ngendlela '[4]' ukumbeza celi 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi yekuhambisa lengasebenti. Sebentisa '[cell]' lapho khona sitokisi kungu 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Inombolo yeceli engahlezi: {cell}. Ingakafikiwa ukuba phakathi kwalezi-0 na {max_cell}.
